title: Dermalogica Circular Hydration Serum Review: Hyaluronic Acid, How to Use It
description:
Dermalogica Circular Hydration Serum: a long-lasting serum that immediately floods skin with hydration and helps prevent hydration evaporation, suitable for all skin types, especially dry or dehydrated skin.

We earn a commission if you buy through our link.

• Long-lasting serum that immediately floods skin with hydration, replenishes from within and helps prevent hydration evaporation
• Suitable for all skin types, especially dryness or dehydration, dullness, fine lines or loss of firmness
• Enhanced form of hyaluronic acid, algae-extract moisturizing matrix, polyglutamic acid from fermented soy
• Plant sugars and amino acids, plus a postbiotic blend of Lactobacillus ferment and oat extract
• Morning and night after toning, before moisturizer: 4-6 drops cover face and neck; patch test first if sensitive to an ingredient
